✂️ CapCut Editing · Lesson 1 of 3

Your First Edit (and the Pro-Badge Trap)

5 min read · Updated November 2026 · Free · Written for Kenya
Share: WhatsApp X Facebook Telegram LinkedIn

The most expensive tap in CapCut isn't an effect. It's adding a Pro-badged sticker, font or transition on a free account, then finding out at export that you must pay or start removing things.

CapCut is still free to download and still does the core job beautifully: cutting vertical video fast on a phone. But in 2026 it is clearly split into Free, Standard and Pro tiers, and the line between them moves by region and app version. Learn the core loop on free tools, and you'll never be held hostage by a paywall.

PlanReported 2026 price (US)What it's for
FreeKES 0Cutting, splitting, keyframes, text, free templates and effects
StandardAbout $9.99/monthRemoves watermarks on some paid items, more templates and effects, 1080p
Pro$19.99/month or $179.99/year4K export, full AI toolkit, large cloud storage

Pro used to cost around $78 a year before CapCut raised it in early 2026. Prices differ by country and are often higher through the app stores, so always check the price shown in your own app.

Your first edit, step by step

  1. Tap New project and select your clips. They land on the timeline in the order you picked them.
  2. Set the canvas to 9:16 first (look for Ratio or Format). Everything you add after this is framed correctly.
  3. Tap a clip to select it. The toolbar switches to clip tools like Split, Speed, Volume.
  4. Move the playhead to where you want a cut and tap Split.
  5. Select the piece you don't want and tap Delete. This is how you remove dead air, bad takes and "ehh, so..."
💡 The badge check

Anything with a small Pro or diamond badge, whether a font, effect, transition, filter or template, can trigger a watermark or a payment prompt when you export on a free plan. Before you build an edit around something pretty, look for the badge. If it's there, decide now, not after 20 minutes of work.

✗ MYTH

A good edit needs transitions, effects and filters.

✓ REALITY

Pacing is what keeps people watching, and pacing comes from Split and Delete. A cuts-only edit with every pause removed usually holds viewers better than a heavily decorated edit that's still slow. Effects are seasoning, not the meal.

  • Download effects and fonts on Wi-Fi. Previewing dozens of templates on Safaricom bundles adds up fast.
  • Export at 1080p for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. It's sharp on phones and keeps upload sizes manageable on mobile data.
  • Name projects by date and topic (e.g. 261101_chapati_tip) so you can find them later.
✅ Do this today
⚡ Quick check

You're on CapCut's free plan and use a Pro-badged transition. What usually happens?

Pro-badged items are the paywall's front door. On a free plan, exporting with them typically means paying, removing them, or accepting a watermark. Check for badges before you build an edit around them.

🧠 Key takeaways
  1. CapCut now has Free, Standard and Pro tiers; prices vary by region.
  2. Pro rose to a reported $179.99/year in 2026 (from about $78).
  3. Look for Pro badges before using any effect, font or template.
  4. Split + Delete is the core skill; pacing beats polish.
